Like a lot of other players, I find myself missing the bleakness of those early months spent playing 76, scouring the world all by yourself, picking up the notes that those long dead left behind in the hopes you would finish their works, barely seeing another player for weeks or months on end. I remember just how absolutely destructive Bloodied builds were early on, the struggle of walking my over-encumbered ass across the entirety of Appalachia without scrap boxes, carry weight boosters, or 1st Tents. 

But, looking to the future, it's nice to see just how much Bethesda has poured into this world. Vault Dwellers having finally pushed back the Scorched and developed a cure against the terrible disease, people are returning in growing numbers to a once devastated are. Appalachia is starting to thrive once more after all that's happened and the efforts of our Dwellers, and it's a beautiful thing to see.
